description: Mini gold-standard sentiment set for TrendWatch AI evaluation. Human labels assigned by reading title + selftext in Reddit context (brand monitoring / general tone). Used to benchmark VADER, weakly supervised LR, and the majority-vote ensemble.
labeling_protocol: One annotator (project author). Positive = favourable or promotional tone; negative = criticism, harm, scandal, or reputational risk; neutral = factual, mixed, humorous-without-attack, or sad-but-affectionate memorial.

Humanity Still Breathes on Our Streets
posts.selftext: This morning near Margaret School, Siliguri, I saw street dogs given rags to sit on and stay warm. Such a small act, yet so powerful. I sincerely thank whoever took this thoughtful step. These voiceless souls endure far more than we ever will, and moments like this remind us that compassion still exists. Humanity lives on, quietly, through actions like these.
